provider: Waiting for first GitHub Action run

geopolitics.summary: The GitHub-native WorldLens pipeline is installed. Add the GEMINI_API_KEY repository secret and run the Update WorldLens workflow once to replace this setup message with a current AI-generated brief.

stories.title: GitHub Action installed
stories.body: WorldLens will retrieve current global reporting through GDELT and ask Gemini to compress the source metadata into three neutral, source-linked stories.
stories.whyItMatters: The API key stays in GitHub Actions rather than browser JavaScript.

stories.title: Scheduled refreshes are configured
stories.body: After activation, the workflow runs every four hours and writes the latest brief to the repository.
stories.whyItMatters: Students see a compact current brief without needing an individual LLM account.

stories.title: Source links remain part of the product
stories.body: The generator maps each AI-written story back to the retrieved source URLs used to construct it.
stories.whyItMatters: Readers can inspect primary reporting instead of treating the model output as authority.

science.summary: The automated science lens is ready to activate from GitHub Actions.

stories.title: Research-aware summarisation
stories.body: The prompt is designed to distinguish research findings, institutional announcements and broader interpretation whenever the retrieved metadata supports that distinction.
stories.whyItMatters: Scientific news is most useful when evidence and claims are not collapsed together.

stories.title: Global retrieval first
stories.body: Current article metadata is gathered before Gemini is called, rather than asking the model to recall recent events from memory.
stories.whyItMatters: Retrieval reduces stale-news and fabrication risk.

stories.title: Three stories, not an endless feed
stories.body: WorldLens deliberately limits each lens to three developments so that the product encourages context rather than doomscrolling.
stories.whyItMatters: The design goal is informed attention, not engagement maximisation.

economy.summary: The economic lens is ready to be generated automatically by the GitHub workflow.

stories.title: Indicators before interpretation
stories.body: The summarisation prompt asks the model to avoid inventing numbers and to keep forecasts or claims attributed when the source metadata supports them.
stories.whyItMatters: Economic reporting often mixes measured indicators with expectations.

stories.title: Broad economic coverage
stories.body: Retrieval queries include inflation, trade, labour, central banks, industry, markets and growth rather than treating market prices as the whole economy.
stories.whyItMatters: Students get a wider picture of economic developments.

stories.title: Automatic GitHub refresh
stories.body: Once the Gemini secret is present, a scheduled Action updates the repository file six times per day.
stories.whyItMatters: The live site can consume fresh summaries without hosting a separate backend.
